versions.content: When calling the function EthSwt_SetSwitchPortMode , the function shall check the access to the Ethernet switch driver. If the check fails, the function shall raise the extended production error ETHSWT_E_ACCESS and return E_NOT_OK , otherwise pass the extended production error ETHSWT_E_ACCESS and re- turn E_OK .
